block-definition.comment: Makes a new oscillator, the module that produces a tone, and reports its settings as a list. Keep the list in a variable: set osc1 to (new oscillator (VCO)) The variable then stands for the oscillator in every other block. Its settings are wave (saw, square, triangle or sine), frequency (in Hz; 261.6 is middle C), control (a module whose signal bends the frequency, in semitones) and trigger (a module whose rising signal restarts the wave). The settings are saved with the project. After loading, the oscillator is rebuilt from them the next time a block uses it.

Changes one setting of an oscillator. Drop the variable holding the oscillator into the first slot. wave: saw, square, triangle or sine frequency: Hz control: the variable of a module whose signal bends the frequency, or an empty slot to unplug it trigger: the variable of a module whose rising signal restarts the wave, or an empty slot to unplug it Stack several of these blocks to set several settings.
Plugs a module into the speaker so you hear it. Drop the variable holding the module into the slot. An empty slot unplugs the speaker and silences the synth; the stop sign does the same.
